## Relevance and limits

The guidance describes GDPR consent as freely given, specific, informed and unambiguous, and addresses withdrawal. It is retained as external design context for consent and access controls. The fictional brief does not specify jurisdiction; applicability of GDPR to the fictional operator is not established. Do not treat this source as a legal opinion or as evidence about customer demand.
